entities.label: users
entities.description: Actors for mutations and comments (humans and agents).

entities.label: projects
entities.description: Workspace container bound to a structure scheme.

entities.label: views
entities.description: Saved board/table lenses (columns, filters, sort).

columns.name: config
columns.title: Config
columns.description: Columns, filters, sort; field refs by id.

entities.label: schemes
entities.description: Structure pack root: types, field library, option sets.

entities.label: item_types
entities.description: Kinds of items within a scheme (task, bug, document, …).

entities.label: item_type_child_types
entities.description: Which child types may hang under a parent type (hierarchy rules).

entities.label: item_type_fields
entities.description: Places a library field on a type (M2M). Definition stays on fields.

columns.name: position
columns.title: Position
columns.description: Order on forms for this type.

columns.name: required
columns.title: Required
columns.description: Must have a value on create/update.

entities.label: fields
entities.description: Scheme-scoped field library (reusable across types).

columns.name: type
columns.title: Type
columns.description: string | number | boolean | date | datetime | option | user | json.

columns.name: config
columns.title: Config
columns.description: Format, multiple, workflow flags, UI hints.

columns.name: option_set_id
columns.title: Option set
columns.description: Shared choices when type is option.

constraints.name: fields_option_set_required
constraints.expression: type <> 'option' OR option_set_id IS NOT NULL

entities.label: option_sets
entities.description: Shared option lists; many option fields can reuse one set.

entities.label: options
entities.description: One choice in an option set (e.g. a status value).

columns.name: kind
columns.title: Kind
columns.description: Lifecycle semantic for workflow options; null for non-workflow options. (todo | active | blocked | done | dropped)

entities.label: option_transitions
entities.description: Workflow graph: which option may move to which (on a workflow field).

columns.name: field_id
columns.title: Field
columns.description: Workflow option field these edges apply to.

columns.name: item_type_id
columns.title: Item type
columns.description: Optional; null = all types using the field.

entities.label: link_types
entities.description: Named relation vocabulary owned by a source type.

columns.name: item_type_id
columns.title: Source type
columns.description: Type that owns this link type.

entities.label: link_type_target_types
entities.description: Which item types may be targets of a given link type.

entities.label: items
entities.description: Record spine (generic work/knowledge object in a project).

entities.label: item_values
entities.description: EAV storage: one row (or N for multi) per field value on an item.

constraints.name: iv_one_value
constraints.expression: num_nonnulls(value_text, value_number, value_date, value_bool, value_json, option_id, value_user_id) = 1

indexes.name: iv_scalar
indexes.where: option_id IS NULL AND value_user_id IS NULL

entities.label: comments
entities.description: Discussion threads on an item.

entities.label: comment_reactions
entities.description: Emoji reactions on comments.

entities.label: item_links
entities.description: Typed edges between two items.

entities.label: events
entities.description: Global append-only log for every aggregate stream.

constraints.name: events_item_project
constraints.expression: aggregate_type <> 'item' OR project_id IS NOT NULL

entities.label: commands
entities.description: One row per accepted command; dedupes multi-event retries.

entities.label: outbox
entities.description: Reliable after-commit handoff to consumers.

columns.name: attempts
columns.title: Attempts
columns.description: Delivery attempts so far; a poison row is retired at 5.

columns.name: last_error
columns.title: Last error
columns.description: Message from the most recent failed delivery.

entities.label: item_activity
entities.description: Per-item activity feed projection (UI diffs).

columns.name: summary
columns.title: Summary
columns.description: UI payload, e.g. before/after for fields.

entities.label: workdirs
entities.description: A directory a session runs in. Optionally linked to a project; a standalone workdir (scratch clone, unrelated repo) has no project.

columns.name: project_id
columns.title: Project
columns.description: Owning project; null for a standalone workdir. A session in a project-linked workdir can comment back on an item.

columns.name: path
columns.title: Path
columns.description: Absolute directory path on the runner.

columns.name: container_name
columns.title: Container
columns.description: Container to exec in; null for the local runner.

columns.name: git_remote
columns.title: Git remote
columns.description: Origin URL, when the directory is a clone.

entities.label: sessions
entities.description: A PTY session. Independent of agent.sessions — no column here references the agent schema.

columns.name: id
columns.title: Id
columns.description: Primary key. A separate id space from agent.sessions.

columns.name: cwd
columns.title: Cwd
columns.description: Working directory override within the workdir.

columns.name: command
columns.title: Command
columns.description: Resolved shell/command this session was launched with, so Restart can respawn the same process on the same record (null for rows created before this column existed → Restart falls back to the default shell).

columns.name: status
columns.title: Status
columns.description: PTY lifecycle. (starting | live | disconnected | exited | failed)

columns.name: exit_code
columns.title: Exit code
columns.description: Process exit status; a PTY fact with no agent analogue.

entities.label: output
entities.description: Raw PTY scrollback, one row per chunk. `seq` is the SSOT a reconnecting browser replays from.

columns.name: data
columns.title: Data
columns.description: Raw bytes as written by the PTY.

entities.label: agents
entities.description: The persona library. Each agent owns a users row with kind='agent', which is what makes it assignable and attributable.

columns.name: user_id
columns.title: User
columns.description: The users row this persona acts as.

columns.name: provider_key
columns.title: Provider
columns.description: Selects a code-registered AgentProvider, not a DB row.

columns.name: permission_mode
columns.title: Permission mode
columns.description: How a tool call decides it needs a human. (default | acceptEdits | bypassPermissions | plan | dontAsk)

columns.name: mcp_servers
columns.title: MCP servers
columns.description: MCP server config passed to the run.

entities.label: sessions
entities.description: An agent run. Independent of terminal.sessions — no column here references the terminal schema. No `kind` (this schema only holds agent runs) and no `exit_code` (a run has a result, not a process status).

columns.name: id
columns.title: Id
columns.description: Primary key. A separate id space from terminal.sessions.

columns.name: item_id
columns.title: Item
columns.description: Ticket the run is working on.

columns.name: parent_session_id
columns.title: Parent session
columns.description: Self-reference: the dispatch tree. A terminal never parents anything, so this lives only here.

columns.name: status
columns.title: Status
columns.description: Agent-turn lifecycle. (starting | running | idle | awaiting_input | interrupted | exited | failed)

columns.name: provider_session_id
columns.title: Provider session
columns.description: Id for resuming the run with the provider.

columns.name: cwd
columns.title: Cwd
columns.description: Working directory override within the workdir.

columns.name: worktree_path
columns.title: Worktree path
columns.description: Git worktree the run was given.

entities.label: messages
entities.description: One row per AgentEvent — the agent analogue of terminal.output, same seq / persist-before-broadcast discipline.

columns.name: seq
columns.title: Seq
columns.description: Monotonic per session; the replay cursor.

columns.name: kind
columns.title: Kind
columns.description: AgentEvent.type (assistant_text | thinking | tool_use | …). Free text by design — the vocabulary grows in app code, not in a migration.

columns.name: tool_use_id
columns.title: Tool use id
columns.description: Correlates a tool call with its result.

columns.name: parent_tool_use_id
columns.title: Parent tool use id
columns.description: Attributes subagent output to the right nested pane.

entities.label: permission_requests
entities.description: A pending row IS a `canUseTool` promise parked in the supervisor: the session sits in `awaiting_input` until a human decides.

columns.name: tool_name
columns.title: Tool
columns.description: Tool the agent asked to use.

columns.name: input
columns.title: Input
columns.description: Arguments the tool was called with.

columns.name: decision_reason
columns.title: Decision reason
columns.description: Why the human allowed or denied it.
